data_fields.name: release_plays_clip_reversed
data_fields.donor_constant: rule: releasing uses pull clip reversed (flag, no second clip)

best_idea: Drive one shared clip set from a phase state: restart the clip only when a phase is entered, and play a release as the pull clip run backwards, so one asset covers both directions.
decision_why: Phase-edge reset and reverse-play are cheap and remove a second asset for hero and creature poses, but the phase must come from engine state the server sends, not from local input as in the donor cubit.
acceptance: In a duel test, when the hero enters block from idle the block clip frame index starts at 0; leaving block plays the same clip frames in reverse; a second block input while already blocking does not restart the clip.
